facts.text: Serve dessert when the three pixies try to bake Aurora's birthday cake.
facts.why: The pixies baking a cake is from the 1959 animated film. The sources opened for the 2014 film show the pixies as clumsy carers but no cake scene.
facts.fix: Serve dessert when Maleficent crashes the christening and curses baby Aurora.

facts.why: Same problem as the cue. No cake-baking scene is shown in the sources opened for the 2014 film.

facts.text: Mistress, I'm a raven, a man, and a wolf. Pick a shape and I'll fetch the bread. Please, not the dragon.
facts.why: Diaval never says this. It is printed in quote marks. His real line on meeting Maleficent is about being her servant in return for his life.
facts.fix: And in return for saving my life, I am your servant. Whatever you need.

fix_note.text: And in return for saving my life, I am your servant. Whatever you need.

facts.text: The wall of thorns around the castle
facts.why: Maleficent's wall of thorns surrounds the Moors. Stefan later builds an iron thorn wall around his own castle, so the line is only true of his wall.
facts.fix: The wall of thorns around the Moors

vibe.verdict: The Moors setting is right, but the poster has black bars top and bottom and the cake cue is from the older film.
